question.text: Registration of a new Portfolio Manager takes place under:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** PM Regs 2020 Reg 7 (application), 8 (info), 9 (further info), 10 (consideration), 11 (grant of certificate). **The Trap:** Companies Act covers incorporation only; SEBI registration is distinct. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-B unique depth. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Registration process takes 3-6 months typically — plan operational launch around certificate receipt.
